description: Stereo filter that sweeps from lowpass through unfiltered to highpass on one knob

params.text: Sweeps the filter: 20Hz to 7000Hz lowpass below the centre, no filtering across the centre, 300Hz to 7000Hz highpass above it; the tooltip reads the lowpass side as stopping at 2000Hz
Sets the filter Q, 0.707 fully anticlockwise rising to 3 fully clockwise
Picks how many filter stages are cascaded, giving 6dB, 12dB, 18dB or 24dB per octave

inputs.text: Left audio into the filter, and the signal used for both channels when the right jack is empty
Shifts the cutoff sweep, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob and clamped at each end
Shifts the resonance, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob and clamped at each end

outputs.text: The filtered left channel, clamped to ±10V
The filtered right channel, clamped to ±10V

notes: the cutoff knob comes up at the centre, where audio passes through unfiltered; that dead zone covers the middle tenth of the travel, with a short crossfade into the filter either side of it.
